t: Created in 1569 when Pope Pius V made Cosimo I de’ Medici Grand Duke of Tuscany after his conquest of Siena.
Medici Tuscany sheltered Galileo, saw the birth of opera and made Livorno a cosmopolitan free port.
Under the Habsburg-Lorraine grand duke Peter Leopold it abolished torture and the death penalty in 1786.
dyk: Galileo named the four moons of Jupiter he discovered in 1610 the Medicean Stars, in honour of Grand Duke Cosimo II and his brothers.
ev: Siena surrenders to Cosimo I de’ Medici
Pope Pius V makes Cosimo I Grand Duke of Tuscany
The Livornine laws open Livorno to Jews and foreign merchants
Galileo becomes court mathematician to Cosimo II
The Medici line dies out; Francis Stephen of Lorraine succeeds
Peter Leopold’s code abolishes torture and the death penalty
The grand duchy becomes the Kingdom of Etruria
A plebiscite approves annexation to the Kingdom of Sardinia

f.successor: United Provinces of Central Italy; Kingdom of Sardinia
